content: Playwright MCP is Microsofts official Model Context Protocol server, giving AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex CLI control of a real Playwright browser. Agent can navigate, identify interactive elements, write, run, and self debug test scripts, verifying its own work in a closed loop. Uses the accessibility tree by default, no vision model required for standard controls. Capabilities include E2E test authoring and execution, accessibility audits for alt text, ARIA, keyboard navigation, visual or screenshot comparison, and automating manual test scenarios from user stories including form fill and workflow walk throughs.
